question: Which letter-range adorns the all-purposes-accomplishing cakra named sarvārthasādhakaṃ?
premises: It is adorned with ṇa-to-bha letters.
inference: The sarvārthasādhaka cakra is adorned by the ṇa-to-bha letter range.
uncertainties: The isolated verse does not fix whether -am forms are nominative or accusative.
plain_english: The cakra named sarvārthasādhakaṃ is adorned with letters from ṇa to bha.
